title: Where are you?
briefing: Now find out where you are.
tips: The shell is always 'standing' in some directory, even when it doesn't say so out loud.
objective: Print the full path of the directory you are in right now.
hints: Your prompt shows `~`, which is an abbreviation. Ask the machine for the full name.
The command's initials are P-W-D: Print Working Directory.
explanation: You are in /home/player — your home directory, nicknamed `~`. A path starting with `/` is absolute: it begins at the root of one single tree. Disks, devices, configuration, logs: on Linux everything hangs somewhere under /.
